judge.summary: The submitted files contain a complete, functional tic‑tac‑toe implementation. The game logic handles board state, turn alternation, move validation, win/draw detection, and resetting. The Tkinter GUI renders a 3x3 grid, shows turn status, move counts, highlights winning lines, announces results, and provides a New Game button. The code is self‑contained and should run on a standard Python environment with Tkinter support, satisfying the benchmark requirements.
